::: {.proto-facts}
Status
: [In production]{.proto-status .s-prod}

What it is
: Perun records which BigPicture member organisation your [LS AAI](lsaai.qmd) login belongs to. That membership decides which BigPicture services you can use.

Who it's for
: Everyone who uses BigPicture's services. Each organisation's Perun managers add and remove their own members.

Provided by
: Life Science RI, as part of LS AAI. Set up for BigPicture by CSC.

Before you start
: An [LS AAI](lsaai.qmd) login.

How to get access
: Ask your organisation's Perun manager to add you to its group. Your organisation has no Perun manager yet? Write to the Service Desk.

  [Open Perun](https://perun.aai.lifescience-ri.eu/home)
